proposals.primaryEstimand: Difference in query-work relevance for new query families over a fixed candidate catalogue and shared evidence conditions; no unseen-candidate-work claim.

primaryMetric.name: nDCG@10
primaryMetric.candidatePolicy: Rank every eligible canonical work in the fixed catalog.
primaryMetric.idealRanking: Same completely judged eligible candidate catalogue; unresolved eligible pairs block primary scoring.
primaryMetric.unjudgedPolicy: Never silently convert missing or unjudgeable labels to zero.
primaryMetric.poolConditionalScoring: Separate prespecified secondary analysis only; never a substitute for primary complete-catalogue coverage.

secondaryMetrics: judged precision@10 under frozen grade>=2 rule

relevanceCollection.candidatePool: Primary admission requires complete eligible-catalogue coverage; a separately frozen pooled collection may support secondary analysis only.
relevanceCollection.blinding: Hide system names, scores, ranks and generated explanations; randomize work presentation.
relevanceCollection.evidenceScope: Metadata/description relevance can be judged at that scope; sustained mood needs separate qualified work-level evidence.
relevanceCollection.primaryReview: Two distinct-rater non-abstaining judgments per eligible primary pair, plus a separately hash-pinned human review/adjudication source. Syntactic validation does not verify human truth.

leakageControls: Work/edition identity with unresolved joins excluded
For work-held-out supervised studies, group chapters/excerpts/editions/derivative summaries across datasets
B1 partitions query families and seed-work groups while sharing its fixed candidate catalogue
Separate pilot, tuning and final query/seed groups
Freeze temporal feature availability for future interaction studies
Do not promote legacy random tones or title-only text joins
